dimensions.assessment: Applies to elected officials, political appointees, federal agencies, and federal building or program naming designations.
dimensions.evidence: no Federal building, facility, or program may be named, renamed, designated, or redesignated in the name or likeness of any elected official or political appointee

dimensions.assessment: Restricts federal naming conventions and requires federal agency Inspectors General to investigate complaints within 90 days.
dimensions.evidence: The inspector general of each Federal agency shall investigate complaints alleging violations of this Act within the respective agency

dimensions.assessment: Negligible fiscal impact consisting primarily of internal agency oversight and Inspector General investigations.
dimensions.evidence: The inspector general of each Federal agency shall investigate complaints alleging violations of this Act

dimensions.assessment: Creates a government-wide statutory restriction on federal facility and program naming conventions and mandates Inspector General reporting.
dimensions.evidence: Notwithstanding any other provision of law, no Federal building, facility, or program may be named, renamed, designated, or redesignated in the name or likeness of any elected official or political appointee

dimensions.assessment: Permanent federal standard restricting naming for at least 10 years post-office or during high commercial name earnings.
dimensions.evidence: until the date that is 10 years after the date on which such individual last held office or appointment.

missing_information: Current number of federal buildings or programs named after living elected officials or political appointees
importance_detail.rationale: The bill prohibits naming or renaming any federal building, facility, or program after any elected official or political appointee while in office or for 10 years after leaving office (or longer if they generate over $1,000,000 annually from commercial use of their name or likeness), and requires agency Inspector General investigations.
